title: Weekend mini coverage census — March 2026
content:
Purpose: quick, shareable spreadsheet-style snapshot for coordinating weekend coverage for a lightweight feature toggle rollout and related customer check-ins. Use this to assign eyes-on-deck, backups, escalation hops, and a minimal runbook for the 48-hr window (Fri 18:00 UTC → Sun 18:00 UTC).

Summary: we expect two small spikes from feature rollout (canary) and one enterprise customer smoke test. Primary risk windows: Fri 19:00–22:00 UTC (canary waves), Sat 10:00–14:00 UTC (customer smoke). Need low-latency on-call and SRE support for rollback.

Sheet (rows = coverage shifts):

ID,Owner,Role,Shift window (UTC),Coverage type,Primary contact (phone),Slack,Status,Backup owner,Escalation (1st/2nd),Notes
1,Asha Patel,Primary PM,Fri 18:00-22:00,Feature rollout owner,+1-415-555-0131,@asha,confirmed,Diego Martinez,Eng Lead / SRE Lead,watch rollout dashboard + notify if error-rate > 0.8%
2,Liam O'Connor,Oncall Eng,Fri 18:00-23:59,Infra & endpoints,+1-415-555-0178,@liam,confirmed,Anya Chen,SRE Pager,able to toggle back if QPS surge > baseline*1.5
3,Diego Martinez,SRE Lead,Sat 09:00-15:00,Customer smoke & latency,+1-415-555-0192,@diego,in_progress,Priya Menon,Eng Lead / Product,run smoke checklist, check KV cache warmup
4,Priya Menon,Support Liaison,Sat 09:00-18:00,Customer comms,+1-415-555-0144,@priya,confirmed,Elisa Park,CS Escal,monitor customer channel; prep templated status notes
5,Anya Chen,Secondary Oncall,Fri 22:00-Sat 10:00,Failover watch,+1-415-555-0155,@anya,available,Liam O'Connor,SRE Lead,standby for failover and DB ops
6,Elisa Park,CS Escal,Sun 08:00-18:00,Customer follow-up,+1-415-555-0122,@elisa,available,Priya Menon,Customer Success Manager,collect issues for Monday post-mortem

Quick metrics to watch (metrics + thresholds):
- error_rate / 1m: alert if > 0.8% (P1 watch)
- 95th latency (text gen): alert if > 450ms longer than baseline
- token egress cost spike: if > 2x expected for 15m window -> notify finance ops

Runbook snippets (copy/paste friendly):
- rollback toggle: CONSOLE → Routes → rollout-toggle → set to previous canary-complete (owner: Asha)
- cache warmup: run `scripts/warmup_prefixes --env prod --samples 5000` (SRE)
- diagnostic collection: run `collect-dump --span 5m --include-kv` and attach to ENG-4823

Action items (owner — due):
- Asha — finalize rollback note + publish templated status msg (Due: 2026-03-11 17:00 UTC)
- Liam — confirm infra runbook and ensure ssh jumpbox keys valid (Due: 2026-03-11 18:30 UTC)
- Diego — prepare smoke test user credentials and checklist (Due: 2026-03-11 20:00 UTC)
- Priya — draft customer-facing note and QA with CS (Due: 2026-03-12 09:00 UTC)

Open questions / unknowns (notes to self):
- Do we have capacity headroom in eu-west-1 for the canary + customer smoke concurrently? (quick ask to infra: slack thread #infra-capacity)
- Are there any scheduled infra maintenances that might overlap? I think there is a disk patch scheduled Fri 02:00 UTC — confirm and consider blackout windows.

Fallback plans:
- If error-rate crosses threshold: initiate rollback (Asha) -> alert SRE -> open incident channel #prod-incident and set bridge.
- If customer reports data issues: CS Escal (Elisa) to open a postmortem doc and pause further canary waves.

Mini checklist for handoff to next-day owners:
- Timebox: 10 minutes readout at shift end
- Attach logs + KV warmup evidence to shift notes
- Confirm backup owner has acceptance and contactability

References and links:
- Canary PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2872
- Incident playbook (lite): https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/SHORT/ops-playbook-lite
- Jira: ENG-4823 (rollout), CS-1298 (customer smoke)

Notes (informal):
- rough crib: pulled from previous weekend template but pared down — keep this doc intentionally sparse so it works well as a pasted table into Slack / calendar invites.
- 'notes to self': remind on Monday to collect post-rollout cost delta and embed in Optimize repo for future guidance.

Change log:
- 2026-03-11 16:00 UTC — initial draft by Asha
- 2026-03-12 08:45 UTC — added backup owners + metrics thresholds (Liam)

End of doc.
